test_title: PYST 69: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 19 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

The school will hire new teachers.

options.text: New teachers will join the school.
The school will be hiring new teachers.
New teachers are hired by the school.
New teachers will be hired by the school.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "The school will hire new teachers."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "new teachers" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "will hire" to "will be hired" (future simple passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "the school."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"New teachers will be hired by the school."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"New teachers will join the school." – This is in active voice and changes the verb.
 
• **Option 2: **"The school will be hiring new teachers." – This is in active voice and uses the continuous form.
 
• **Option 3: **"New teachers are hired by the school." – This is present tense, not future tense.
